item.title: Mullally warns of the dangers of assisted suicide
item.description: A future archbishop and two past prime ministers all agree assisted suicide is dangerous.

item.title: 9 prayers for 2026: Stepping into the New Year trusting God
item.description: A new year always brings a mixture of emotions. Some of us step into 2026 with excitement, others with uncertainty, grief or quiet weariness. Many carry hopes for change, healing, or fresh beginnings.

item.title: Christian organisations caught up in Israeli aid agency ban
item.description: Israel is preventing 37 aid groups from operating in Gaza unless they comply with controversial guidelines that critics say would put Palestinian staff at risk.

item.title: Netanyahu pledges support for persecuted Christians
item.description: In an apparent attempt to bolster weakening US public support for Israel, Benjamin Netanyahu has said that he will join American efforts to protect persecuted Christians around the world.

item.title: Evangelical churches continue to grow across Spain
item.description: The number of evangelical churches in Spain is now near the 5,000 mark.

item.title: Abortion was leading cause of death worldwide in 2025
item.description: More than 73 million abortions were performed worldwide in 2025, making abortion the leading cause of death last year. The figure draws on World Health Organization estimates compiled by the global data-tracking platform Worldometers.

item.title: Over a million Australians attend church each week - study
item.description: New national data suggests Australia’s churches are continuing a gradual recovery in weekly attendance following the COVID-19 pandemic, while still falling short of levels seen at the turn of the millennium.

item.title: Church community projects linked to falling antisocial behaviour and crime
item.description: A Croydon council estate once known locally for disorder and intimidation has seen markedly better trends in crime and antisocial behaviour over the past decade, with a new study suggesting sustained church-led community projects played a significant role.

item.title: Christians react to US capture of Maduro
item.description: Some Christian leaders have been enthusiastic about US actions in Venezuela, while others have been more cautious.

item.title: I love Jesus, but do I need church?
item.description: Don’t let fear, doubt, or even pride keep you on the sidelines.
